results.title: Attio ditches per-seat pricing for workspace plans, adds $1,000 Ultra tier — Nov 16, 2026 · PricingSaaS Pulse
results.snippet: Between the Nov 9, 2026 and Nov 16, 2026 captures of Attio's pricing page, Pulse recorded 2 changes: Per-seat pricing replaced by per-workspace base prices (Plus $40, Pro $100 incl. 1 user, add users extra); new Ultra plan $1,000/mo incl. 5 users; paid add-ons for extra records and objects; New plan features: SQL queries via API/MCP, data connector, data rules, audit logs, governance add-on and forward-deployed onboarding. Pulse files it as a packaging change (packaging change, feature added). [...] Per-seat pricing replaced by per-workspace base prices (Plus $40, Pro $100 incl. 1 user, add users extra); new Ultra plan $1,000/mo incl. 5 users; paid add-ons for extra records and objects; New plan features: SQL queries via API/MCP, data connector, data rules, audit logs, governance add-on and forward-deployed onboarding. Pulse compared the captures it took on Nov 9, 2026 and Nov 16, 2026 UTC; the before/after table above lists each item as written on the page. [...] This weekly roll-up includes the change Pulse first recorded in a shorter period: "Attio shifts to per-workspace pricing, adds $1,000/mo Ultra plan" (Day 315, 2026, saved Nov 11, 2026). It also records changes none of that period did (feature added), so Pulse counts it as a change of its own. Before that, Attio's previous recorded change was "Attio: Formula attributes feature added to Pro and Enterprise plans" (Aug 2, 2026). Attio has been tracked since 2026-05-05.
